Hi Mark — thanks for the clear list. Happy to run the kickoff. Wednesday 15:00 PST works on our side; I'll send a calendar invite after I confirm with infra.

Quick answers up front so your team can prep:
- We'll send a Redwood SP metadata file (saml-metadata.xml) and SP ACS/EntityID details before the call.
- SCIM: Redwood's Private CP supports SCIM v2 with bearer-token auth for the provisioning endpoint. The recommended token rotation is 90 days by default; we can do shorter for enterprise customers.
- Mapping model: we support authoritative SCIM group sync (recommended) or SAML group/attribute assertion mapping as a fallback. For your use case, authoritative SCIM group sync is preferable to keep AD/Okta as the source of truth.
- Networking: we support two options: (1) public SP + IP allowlist (we'll provide a set of stable egress IPs for the control plane) or (2) a private peering endpoint (VPC peering / private link) for on-prem customers — the peering option requires an extra infra lead time (2-3 weeks) but eliminates public exposure.

I'll loop in Dev for the exact SCIM schema and our SAML NameID preferences. Attached: Redwood SAML metadata (saml-metadata.xml).

Next steps:
1) Confirm kickoff time (Wednesday 15:00 PST)
2) Share IdP metadata export from your side (Okta/ADFS)
3) Internal runbook draft + SCIM token issuance steps

@Mina / Laura — noted. A few technical clarifications for the kickoff so Acme can prepare the infra: 

1) SCIM endpoint and auth
   - Endpoint: https://scim.privatecp.redwood.com/acme/scim/v2/Users
   - Auth: Bearer token (long-lived, rotatable). We'll generate the initial token and add it to the runbook.

2) SCIM schema and group mapping
   - We support SCIM v2 core with the groups extension. Recommended canonical mapping:
     * acme-eng -> redwood-operator
     * acme-prod-admins -> redwood-admin
     * acme-analysts -> redwood-viewer
   - Delta sync supported (PATCH operations) — we recommend delta-only syncs during business hours to reduce churn.

3) SAML details
   - Preferred NameID: email (transient/unspecified acceptable)
   - We support SP-initiated and IdP-initiated. For automated provisioning flows (onboarding via API), SP-initiated is marginally simpler for audit trails.

4) RBAC nuances
   - Redwood roles map to privileges: admin (full control, includes billing access), operator (deployments, logs), viewer (read-only). If Acme needs a custom role, we can add a tenant-scoped role; this takes a week for entitlement plumbing.

5) Network
   - IP allowlist: 34.201.120.45, 34.201.120.46, 34.201.120.47 (standby range) — we'll provide a /32 list and update in prod cutover.
   - Private peering: requires an LR/Tunnel config doc which I can share.

I've attached a short SCIM spec cheat-sheet. We'll be prepared to walk through examples on the call.

Attachment: scim-spec-sheet.pdf
